newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Holderbank puts $80 mln into Colombia cement plant.
newsitem.headline: Holderbank puts $80 mln into Colombia cement plant.

text.p: Switzerland's Holderbank said Monday that it had successfully concluded the upgrading of its Cementos Boyaca SA cement plant in central Colombia after spending $80 million to make it the biggest in the country.
"The start-up of the new installations, of the biggest and most modern cement plant in Colombia, has been successfully concluded," Holderbank, the world leading cement producer, said in a statement.
It said the plant, in central Boyaca province, now has a production capacity of 1.7 million metric tons a year and that capacity could easily be boosted to a total of 2.1 million metric tons.
The upgrading of the plant was supervised by Holderbank Engineering Canada and took 18 months, the statement said.
